basic_info.description: Welcome to this bright, tri-level live/work loft located in the Dogpatch area of Potrero Hill,one of the city's most desired locations.This corner end-unit condo offers aprx. 997 square feet of flexible living space, with two full bathrooms and the potential for two bedrooms. Designed with versatility in mind, the home features a private street-level entrance that opens into a spacious room ideal for a home office, studio, client-facing business, or second bedroom. The main level boasts soaring ceilings, abundant natural light, and a cozy fireplace in the living area, which flows seamlessly onto a private terrace with views  the perfect spot for morning coffee or relaxing at sunset. A striking spiral staircase leads to the lofted primary suite complete with its own full bath. Additional highlights include in-unit laundry, one-car parking with storage,with  additional guest parking available. HOA dues cover water, garbage, and internet. Commuters will appreciate the quick access to Caltrain, Muni, and the 101/280 freeways,and just minutes from Chase Center, Oracle Park, Pier 70, and the vibrant dining and shopping. Ideal for creatives, entrepreneurs, or anyone seeking modern city living with a flexible floor plan, this distinctive loft truly has it all.
